text: Once seeds 70-72 cover e ceilings 0.5, 0.6, 0.7 and 0.85, is raw accel_step R2 flat (about 0.87) up to 0.6 and then falling, while control R2 falls steadily? If so, every margin gain between e<=0.5 and e<=0.7 is a control effect, and margin comparisons across eccentricity should use raw R2 or headroom-normalized margin instead.
